text.arabic_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

words.gloss_range: independent first-person plural pronoun used for divine self-reference in the ayah opening
words.prose: {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) is not a disposable subject marker: it opens the ayah with explicit divine self-reference, so the following knowledge claim begins from the speaker rather than from the deniers' speech. Its plural form is narrowed to majestic divine register, not multiple speakers, and its first-person frame returns at the final owned warning.

topics.headline: explicit divine subject opens the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts from the divine speaker before it names what people say.
topics.reason: Arabic could often leave the subject implicit, but the independent pronoun stands first and frames the whole closing instruction.

topics.headline: plural form as majestic register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not mistake the plural form for a count of speakers; it works as an authoritative divine register.
topics.reason: Referent evidence identifies the divine speaker, so the plural is retained as register and authority rather than arithmetic plurality.

topics.headline: opening frame returns at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from first-person divine self-reference to the final first-person warning.
topics.reason: The first word preserves divine voice across the boundary from the prior resurrection scene and anticipates the possessed warning at the end.

words.gloss_range: elative predicate: most knowing or more knowing, locally aimed at what they say
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge root with knowing, marking, sign, and landmark associations; the local sense is divine knowledge, with marker precision as lexical pressure
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) makes divine knowledge a standing predicate rather than a new event. Its elative shape keeps both superlative and comparative pressure available while the attached object narrows the domain to their speech; the {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) background adds the sense of precise marking, not vague awareness. The closing use also recalls the surah's earlier knowledge answer at 50:4, and its smoother sound contrasts with the later heavy coercion term.

topics.headline: standing elative knowledge predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge presented as a stable divine attribute, not a reaction to their latest words.
topics.reason: The word is khabar of the opening pronoun in a nominal clause, so the knowledge claim has standing predicative force.

topics.headline: superlative and comparative pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both most-knowing and more-knowing force, while the local phrase limits the comparison to what they say.
topics.reason: The afʿal form permits elative range, but the prepositional complement supplies the local domain.

topics.headline: knowledge as precise marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears divine knowing as exact cognitive marking of their speech, not generalized awareness.
topics.reason: The marker-landmark branch can color the knowledge claim, while the local form still selects knowing as the active sense.

topics.headline: knowledge of speech formula returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that divine knowledge is aimed at human speech and resumes the surah's earlier knowledge theme at 50:4.
topics.reason: The recurrence evidence links the elative knowledge expression with speech and with Surah Qaf's earlier knowledge answer.

topics.headline: lighter sound against coercion word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound contrast between the knowledge claim and the later heavy coercion term.
topics.reason: The row supplies a local acoustic contrast with the later predicate, so it is retained as secondary payoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the relative object of knowledge; concerning or about
words.prose: The first {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) does the work of aiming the knowledge predicate: it turns the elative from bare knowing into knowing about the speech content that follows. Its fused position before the relative word makes the domain of divine knowledge visible before the saying clause is complete, and it begins the ayah's threefold pattern of the same particle with different functions.

topics.headline: bāʾ directs knowledge to speech content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is not abstract here; it is grammatically aimed at what they say.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative complement after the elative predicate and specifies the domain of knowing.

topics.headline: proclitic binds the object phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the object of knowledge begin as a compact bound phrase before the relative clause unfolds.
topics.reason: The written attachment to the following relative word makes the dependency immediate.

topics.headline: first of three bāʾ functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track one repeated particle through knowledge, negation, and instrument without collapsing their functions.
topics.reason: The ayah repeats the particle in three positions, each with a different grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: relative or verbal-noun particle in the knowledge object slot; locally open in scope
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the object of divine knowledge open: it can be read as what they say or as their saying, so both content and act remain in view. The word also delays completion of the first beat until the following verb fills the relative clause, making the knowledge object structurally unfold inside the ayah.

topics.headline: content and act remain possible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge covers not only statements as content but also the act of their saying.
topics.reason: The particle can be relative or maṣdariyya, but the local attachment keeps both readings inside the object slot rather than creating separate claims.

topics.headline: undelimited speech object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speech object left maximally open instead of narrowed to one quoted claim.
topics.reason: The open relative does not delimit which statement is known.

topics.headline: relative clause completes first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first clause waiting for the saying verb to complete its object.
topics.reason: The relative word opens the dependent clause that supplies the object governed after the elative.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect third masculine plural: ongoing collective saying
words.root_gloss_range: speech root covering saying, speech, and discourse; local sense is their ongoing utterance, not fabricated speech or reciprocal dispute
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqūlūna}}) completes the first knowledge object as ongoing plural speech: the speakers are encoded in the verb ending without being renamed, so the focus stays on the speech-field God knows. The {{ar:ق و ل}} ({{tr:q-w-l}}) form is simple Form I, naming what they keep saying rather than making the Prophet a disputant or restricting the claim to fabricated speech. In the surah thread, continuing human speech is set under divine knowledge after earlier divine dispute speech at 50:28, and the final nasal sound points the ear onward toward the closing warning.

topics.headline: imperfect plural ongoing speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known speech is continuous collective discourse, not one past utterance.
topics.reason: The imperfect third-person plural form carries ongoing aspect and plural subject agreement.

topics.headline: subject carried inside verb ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deniers grammatically present without the ayah needing to name them again.
topics.reason: The plural ending supplies the subject while the relative object foregrounds speech content.

topics.headline: simple saying not dispute morphology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the broad utterance-field without importing fabricated-speech or reciprocal-dispute morphology.
topics.reason: Related derived forms exist, but the local verb is Form I and should not be over-specified.

topics.headline: human speech under divine speech thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a surah-local contrast between continuing human speech and adjudicating divine speech at 50:28.
topics.reason: Surah Qaf repeatedly stages speech, and this closing occurrence gathers human saying under the knowledge claim.

topics.headline: speech-root prominence and nasal link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the self-aware speech vocabulary and the sound link from their speech toward the final warning.
topics.reason: The high-frequency speech root and local nasal closure provide secondary lexical and acoustic payoff.

words.gloss_range: connector between the knowledge declaration and the negated address; additive, contrastive, or circumstantial force is possible
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge from divine knowledge to prophetic role. Its range can be additive, contrastive, or circumstantial, but locally the payoff is that the two beats stay connected while remaining distinct: what God knows does not become what the Prophet may coerce. The short reset also prepares the negated second-person clause.

topics.headline: additive, contrastive, or circumstantial hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that non-coercion can be heard as joined to, set against, or simultaneous with divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The connector allows several relations, but all keep the second beat tied to the first.

topics.headline: We-to-you role distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from God's knowledge to the Prophet's limited role.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the address clause and helps prevent divine and prophetic roles from collapsing.

topics.headline: short reset before negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compact break before the heavy coercion predicate enters.
topics.reason: The clipped sequence opens the second beat after the saying clause.

words.gloss_range: negative particle scoping over the full nominal predicate chain
words.prose: The second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens a categorical nominal negation: the ayah does not merely forbid coercive behavior, it denies that the addressee is such a compeller over them. The Ḥijāzī versus Tamīmī case question is narrowed because the following emphatic preposition absorbs the visible case pressure, while the role-excluding force remains clear.

topics.headline: whole predicate chain negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that coercive identity is denied categorically, not just discouraged as conduct.
topics.reason: The negative particle scopes over the subject, authority phrase, and predicate in a nominal clause.

topics.headline: Ḥijāzī and Tamīmī parse pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the grammatical parse pressure without making it carry the main meaning.
topics.reason: The dialectal distinction is real, but the attached predicate preposition prevents it from changing the local denial.

words.gloss_range: explicit second-person masculine singular pronoun under negation
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) makes the non-coercion clause personal rather than generic. The ayah first shifts from divine self-reference to direct address, assigns knowledge to God and denies compulsion to the Prophet, and only then gives the imperative; that sequence makes the later command a non-coercive mission rather than an authorization to dominate.

topics.headline: personal second-person subject under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is addressed directly to the Prophet, not stated as an abstract principle.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is retained in the negated clause, making the addressee explicit.

topics.headline: divine We to prophetic you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah distribute roles: God knows, the Prophet is not a compeller, then he is commanded to remind.
topics.reason: The pronoun shift structures the movement from self-declaration into direct instruction.

topics.headline: negation prepares non-coercive command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is prepared by stripping away coercive identity first.
topics.reason: The explicit addressee links the negated identity to the following imperative.

words.gloss_range: preposition over/upon plus third-person plural suffix marking the denied authority relation
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) does more than identify the group; it names the vertical relation being denied, the position of being over them as a compeller. The suffix keeps the same people in view: the ones whose speech God knows are the ones over whom the Prophet is not placed in coercive authority, with the prior resurrection boundary still in the background.

topics.headline: authority relation encoded by over them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies the elevated over-them relation that would make coercion plausible.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase carries vertical authority force inside the negated predicate chain.

topics.headline: suffix resumes the saying group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same group from what they say to over them, without a repeated noun.
topics.reason: The third-person plural suffix resumes the plural group encoded in the earlier verb.

topics.headline: resurrection group remains in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the cosmic scene narrow into the same human group now addressed through non-coercion.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence links the prior scene's group with the present pronoun chain.

words.gloss_range: emphatic preposition in the negative predicate construction
words.prose: The middle {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is not the first particle's knowledge-link or the later instrument marker; it reinforces the negation before the coercion predicate. Its bound position makes the predicate visibly governed by denial, and its short onset clings audibly to the heavy doubled compeller word. Its recurrence in the ayah creates a sequence: knowledge attached, coercion denied, Quran appointed as instrument.

topics.headline: bāʾ strengthens denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial of compeller status is reinforced, not merely stated bare.
topics.reason: The particle functions as the emphatic bāʾ in the negative predicate construction.

topics.headline: preposition fused to denied predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears the negation cling directly to the heavy compeller word.
topics.reason: The proclitic attachment binds the predicate into the negative construction.

topics.headline: second of three bāʾ functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish the ayah's three bāʾ particles by function instead of flattening them into repetition.
topics.reason: This middle occurrence occupies the negation beat between the knowledge and instrument uses.

words.gloss_range: indefinite intensive adjective under negation: any coercive compeller category is denied of the Prophet
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes compelling, forcible restoring, mending, and elevated/unreachable imagery; local sense is the negated coercive identity
words.prose: {{ar:جَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:jabbārin}}) is the ayah's heavy denied identity: indefinite and intensive, it excludes the Prophet from any category of habitual compeller over them. The {{ar:ج ب ر}} ({{tr:j-b-r}}) field gives that denial teeth, because compulsion, forcible restoration, and even unreachable elevation press behind the word while local grammar keeps all of it negated of the human messenger. The contrast with 88:22 and with the divine name at 59:23 sharpens the boundary: irresistible power belongs to God, not to prophetic mission.

topics.headline: any habitual compeller category denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Prophet excluded not from one act of pressure but from the whole identity of a habitual compeller.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness under negation and the faʿʿāl intensive pattern stack a broad category denial.

topics.headline: forcible repair and elevation denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied role includes forceful repair, domination, and unreachable overness, not neutral leadership.
topics.reason: The root images enrich the denied identity, but local negation prevents treating them as an active prophetic attribute.

topics.headline: divine name contrasted with Prophet denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps divine irresistible power distinct from the Prophet's non-coercive commission.
topics.reason: Evidence links the same form-field to a divine name at 59:23 while this ayah negates it of the Prophet.

topics.headline: parallel non-control formula at 88:22
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the near formula of being not over them as a controller at 88:22, with this ayah specializing it as non-compulsion.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah evidence gives a concrete structural parallel with over-them plus negative predicate.

topics.headline: rare heavy force-word sounds compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doubled sound and rare marked word choice carrying the force being denied.
topics.reason: The phonetic and occurrence evidence make the word a marked heavy selection in the middle of the ayah.

topics.headline: divine ease not human coercion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that God's effortless gathering does not authorize coercive human control; the ayah stacks negation, reinforcement, and intensive form to say so.
topics.reason: Boundary and synthesis rows connect the prior divine power scene with the local non-coercion grammar.

words.gloss_range: resultative or explicative conjunction introducing the command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the two declarative premises into an operational conclusion: because God knows and the Prophet is not a compeller, the valid next act is reminder. It shifts the ayah from role definition into imperative mode, and its clipped attachment gives the command a quick onset after the longer setup.

topics.headline: premises yield reminder command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's logic: knowledge plus non-coercion therefore reminder.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the command as the result of the preceding clauses.

topics.headline: unstated conclusion articulated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command as the practical conclusion already implied by the premises.
topics.reason: The explicative reading is compatible locally, but its force remains tied to the resultative command transition.

topics.headline: indicative clauses into imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah change mode from description to command at this particle.
topics.reason: The particle is the hinge between declarative clauses and the single imperative beat.

topics.headline: boundary logic and clipped onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prior divine gathering and local non-coercion resolve into a swift reminder command, not enforcement.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence and cadence both support the particle as a compact transition into action.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperative: cause to remember, remind, admonish; addressed to the Prophet
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mention, reminder, admonition, and prominence; local command is causative activation of recollection through non-coercive reminder
words.prose: {{ar:ذَكِّرْ}} ({{tr:dhakkir}}) is the single imperative and structural climax of the ayah: after divine knowledge and denied compulsion, the Prophet is commanded to activate remembrance. The Form II shape makes him a cause of recollection, not a producer of fear or a coercive controller, and the doubled middle sound gives the command a real push without turning it into compulsion. The {{ar:ذ ك ر}} ({{tr:dh-k-r}}) field adds salience through mention. The command links to reminder scenes at 50:37 and 51:55 while this ayah uniquely specifies the Quranic instrument and fear-filtered audience.

topics.headline: only imperative assigns permitted mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah gives one actual command after denying coercion: remind.
topics.reason: The verb is the only imperative in the ayah and is addressed to the second-person addressee.

topics.headline: Form II activates recollection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Prophet's agency as causing remembrance, not forcing belief.
topics.reason: Form II gives causative reminder force, contrasted with inward recollection forms.

topics.headline: memory and mention made salient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears reminder as making latent knowledge and warning salient through mention.
topics.reason: The broader root field supports salience and mention, while the local form selects the reminder command.

topics.headline: Quranic reminder command specialized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes an established reminder command pattern, here sharpened by Quran as instrument and fear as audience filter, with 51:55 as a concrete echo.
topics.reason: The recurrence evidence links the imperative to 51:55, while local complements make this occurrence more specific.

topics.headline: earlier receptive-heart motif becomes command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing command answer the earlier motif of who can receive reminder at 50:37.
topics.reason: Surah-local evidence connects the root with earlier receptivity and the final commanded act.

topics.headline: audible push without compulsion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears real force in the command while distinguishing it from the denied compeller role.
topics.reason: The sound and synthesis rows preserve the contrast between prompting recognition and imposing from outside.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition marking the Quran as means of reminder
words.prose: The third {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) appoints the means of the reminder: the command is not to remind about the Quran as a topic but to remind by means of it. Its bound position keeps the recitation inseparable from the command's instrument, and as the third occurrence it completes the ayah's sequence from knowledge-link to negation-reinforcer to instrument-marker.

topics.headline: Quran as reminder instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Quran is the tool used for reminding, not merely the subject of a reminder.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the definite noun as the means attached to the imperative.

topics.headline: instrument with accompaniment near
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reminder performed with the recitation as its operating medium.
topics.reason: Instrumental force is primary locally, while accompaniment remains adjacent but not controlling.

topics.headline: proclitic binds means to Quran
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears the instrument attached immediately to the Quran rather than delayed.
topics.reason: The proclitic form makes the instrumental relation immediate in writing and recitation.

topics.headline: third bāʾ completes particle logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can follow the same particle organizing three different relations across the ayah.
topics.reason: This third occurrence completes the knowledge, negation, instrument sequence.

words.gloss_range: definite singular Quran governed by instrumental preposition as the known means of reminder
words.root_gloss_range: reading, reciting, gathering, and compiled recitation; local sense is the known Quran as gathered recited instrument
words.prose: {{ar:الْقُرْآنِ}} ({{tr:al-Qurʾāni}}) is definite and singular, so the command uses the already-known Quran as one gathered instrument of reminder. The {{ar:ق ر ء}} ({{tr:q-r-ʾ}}) field keeps recitation and gathering together, while the derivational dispute with joining is narrowed to supporting the compiled-recitation payoff rather than replacing the local root. The hamza remains a recitational pressure point even where variant sound smooths it without changing the referent. The word also completes the surah ring: the Quran sworn by at 50:1 becomes the operational medium at 50:45, and the exact command is marked as a singular formulation.

topics.headline: known definite Quran as instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command does not introduce an indefinite recitation; it uses the known Quran as one definite instrument.
topics.reason: Definiteness, singularity, and instrumental government make the noun a known means of reminder.

topics.headline: recited and gathered corpus pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Quran as both recited speech and gathered textual corpus in the reminder instrument.
topics.reason: The root and derivational evidence support recitation/gathering and joining pressure, but local sense remains the Quran.

topics.headline: hamza acoustic pressure without referent change
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hamza as a recitational pressure point while the referent remains fixed.
topics.reason: Variant evidence changes sound shape, not the identity of the Quran named here.

topics.headline: opening oath becomes closing instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Quran move from sworn-by object at 50:1 to the instrument of reminder at 50:45.
topics.reason: The same noun frames the surah, and the closing use turns the opening object into operational medium.

topics.headline: singular command to remind by Quran
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this as a marked formulation of Quran-as-instrument, not a routine reminder phrase.
topics.reason: The rows report the exact command as unique, so the local construction carries formulaic markedness.

words.gloss_range: human relative or conditional pronoun serving as the object of the reminder command
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) identifies the receiver of the reminder, not its instrument. Its relative or conditional range keeps the class open, but the following fear clause filters that openness: anyone may fall under the address only as one who fears the divine warning. After the prior cosmic resurrection scene, the word narrows the horizon to the receptive hearer.

topics.headline: relative or conditional receiver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both the one who fears and whoever fears as possible force for the reminder target.
topics.reason: The particle can be relative or conditional, but both readings function within the object phrase of the command.

topics.headline: person targeted, Quran used
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes whom the Prophet reminds from what he reminds with.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the human relative phrase the object while the Quran phrase is the means.

topics.headline: open class restricted by fear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is not everyone indiscriminately but whoever meets the fear criterion.
topics.reason: The pronoun is semantically open, and the following verb supplies the restrictive condition.

topics.headline: cosmic scene to receptive hearer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing command narrow from multitudes in resurrection to the individual receptive audience.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence marks the scale shift from the prior ayah into this filtered object phrase.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect third masculine singular: ongoing fear by the grammatically singular relative head
words.root_gloss_range: fear as anticipation of harm and risk; local sense is ongoing apprehension of the divine threat, distinct from reverential awe
words.prose: {{ar:يَخَافُ}} ({{tr:yakhāfu}}) makes fear the live predicate that filters the reminder's audience: grammatically singular with the relative head, but open to whoever remains in that state. The {{ar:خ و ف}} ({{tr:kh-w-f}}) choice points to anticipation of harm, not reverential awe, because the direct object is the divine threat, and the constricted guttural onset suits that apprehension. Form I keeps fear inside the receiver rather than making the Prophet frighten others, and the phrase joins a warning-response pair that echoes the fear-root contrast at 50:33.

topics.headline: ongoing fear defines receiver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target is whoever is presently characterized by fear, not someone who merely feared once.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb agrees singularly with the relative head and supplies the audience criterion.

topics.headline: fear as anticipated harm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the fear as future-facing apprehension of consequence, not generic emotion or reverential knowledge.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence distinguishes this root from reverential awe, and the direct object is the warning.

topics.headline: receiver fears, Prophet does not frighten
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fear located in the recipient rather than produced by a causative frightening form.
topics.reason: The local Form I blocks importing Form II frightening or Form V gradual nuance as the active sense.

topics.headline: fear paired with divine threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fear and threat functioning as one local mechanism: response beside warned consequence.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and adjacency link the fear root with the warning root in the final phrase.

topics.headline: fear roots bracket final section
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes fear of the named warning here from the reverent unseen fear at 50:33.
topics.reason: The concrete 50:33 echo compares two fear roots without making them identical.

topics.headline: guttural onset in receptive audience synthesis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the constricted onset and sees the audience defined by live relation to warning.
topics.reason: The acoustic row and synthesis row preserve how the fear verb helps form the receptive audience.

words.gloss_range: verbal noun/threat noun with first-person possessive force: My warning or threat as the feared object
words.root_gloss_range: promise and threat field, appointed commitment, and negative promised consequence; local sense is a severe divine-owned warning
words.prose: {{ar:وَعِيدِ}} ({{tr:waʿīdi}}) closes the ayah and the surah on the object feared: a warning owned by the divine speaker. The possessive can be heard through suppressed or explicit yāʾ readings, and the iḍāfa range is narrowed to divine agency or divine domain without losing the point that the threat is God's. The {{ar:و ع د}} ({{tr:w-ʿ-d}}) field makes threat a binding future commitment, the negative side of promise; as final word, its sparse marked form and long closing sound make the warning the audible landing point. It gathers Surah Qaf's warning thread from 50:14 and lands the Quran-reminder ring on a first-person divine warning.

topics.headline: first-person owned warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feared object is not abstract threat but God's own warning.
topics.reason: The word carries first-person possessive force, with variant evidence making the possessive explicit in some readings.

topics.headline: subjective or objective possessive reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both My threatening and threat concerning My punishment as local possibilities.
topics.reason: Both iḍāfa roles are permitted, but each preserves divine ownership rather than changing the referent.

topics.headline: threat as promised harm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warning as a binding negative promise, not a casual menace.
topics.reason: The root covers promise and threat, while the local noun selects the negative promised consequence.

topics.headline: severe future commitment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the threat as temporally fixed and durable enough to be feared.
topics.reason: Appointment-field and faʿīl-form evidence strengthen severity, while local object relation keeps the sense warning or threat.

topics.headline: Surah Qaf warning culmination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final word as the culmination of the surah's repeated warning vocabulary, especially 50:14 and 50:45.
topics.reason: The root recurs across Surah Qaf and repeatedly marks closing warning points.

topics.headline: surah closes on divine warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the whole surah land not on the audience or Prophet but on God's owned warning.
topics.reason: The word's final position gives maximum closure weight to the first-person warning.

topics.headline: marked noun and final rhyme closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sparse marked threat form and the final long sound as the audible landing point.
topics.reason: Occurrence grouping and fāṣila evidence make the closing noun formally and acoustically marked.

topics.headline: speaker-text-warning ring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees opening divine speaker, Quranic instrument, ongoing fear, and final owned threat converge into one closing architecture.
topics.reason: The synthesis rows connect first-person frame, Quran instrument, fear, and possessive warning.

branches.image_en:
1. collecting and gathering
2. gathering speech into recitation
branches.scope_ar:
1. يدخل فيه أصل الجمع والاجتماع، وضم الشيء بعضه إلى بعض، وجمع الماء والطعام والناس والضيف، واجتماع عظام الظهر، وما ألحقته المقاييس بقرية من جهة الجمع.
2. قراءة القرآن والكلام؛ لفظه مجموعا؛ إقراء الغير؛ المدارسة والاستقراء؛ القارئ والقراء والتقرؤ للتنسك أو التفقه
branches.scope_en:
1. This covers the root image of collecting, joining, and gathering: things gathered together, water or food gathered in a vessel, people gathered in a settlement, guests gathered around a dish, and the back as gathered bones.
2. Reading or reciting Quran or speech, uttering it as a gathered whole, making another read, studying together or eliciting reading, and reader or devotional-learning uses.

branches.image_en:

2. appointed time or cycle
branches.scope_ar:
1. يدخل فيه قراءة القرآن والكتاب والشعر والحديث، والقرآن اسما ومصدرا، وقراءة الشيء على غيره، وإقراء غيره، والمقارأة والمدارسة والاستقراء.
2. القُرء وقت الحيض والطهر؛ وقت هبوب الرياح؛ ضبعة الناقة؛ قَرأة البلاد
branches.scope_en:
1. This covers reading or reciting Qur'an, a book, poetry, or report; Qur'an as a name or verbal noun; reading to another; teaching another to recite; and mutual study.
2. Periodic or appointed time: menstrual or purity period, wind season, animal heat, and a period after entering a land.

branches.image_ar:
1. قرء الحيض والطهر
2. اجتماع الرحم وحمله
branches.image_en:
1. cycle period of menstruation and purity
2. womb gathering and bearing
branches.scope_ar:
1. يدخل فيه القرء والأقراء والقروء للحيض، وللطهر، ولانقضاء الحيض، ولما بين الحيضتين، وللدخول من الطهر في الحيض، ولعدة النساء.
2. ما يضمه الرحم من جنين أو دم؛ حمل الناقة أو المرأة؛ طرح السلى والولد في بعض الأقوال
branches.scope_en:
1. This covers qur' and its plurals for menstruation, purity, the end of menstruation, the interval between two menstruations, entering menstruation after purity, and women's waiting-period usage.
2. Womb-related gathering, bearing, or its idiomatic negation, including fetus, blood, pregnancy, and reported casting meanings.

branches.image_ar:

2. إبلاغ السلام بصيغته
branches.image_en:
1. devout or learned reader
2. conveying greeting by formula
branches.scope_ar:
1. يدخل فيه القارئ بمعنى العابد الناسك، والقراء المتنسك، والتقرأ بمعنى التنسك أو التفقه أو التفهم.
2. قول اقرأ عليه السلام؛ اقترىء مني السلام؛ ترك أقرئه السلام في هذا النقل
branches.scope_en:
1. This covers qari' as a devotee or ascetic, qurra' as devout readers, and taqarra'a as becoming devout, learned, or understanding.
2. Formulaic expression for conveying greetings: say اقرأ عليه السلام or اقترىء مني السلام, with the cited warning against أقرئه السلام.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نحن أعلم بما يقولون ... وما أنت عليهم بجبار ... فذكر بالقرآن من يخاف وعيد
baseline_models.mechanism: Complete divine knowledge of resistant speech is paired with an explicit ban on coercive mastery. The permitted response is to make the threatened future present again through recitation for a hearer already disposed to anticipate it.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower assigns full cognition of their speech to God and bounds the messenger's task.
Externally produced speech is the resistance known and answered by the final command.
Overpowering compulsion is explicitly negated and fixes the method's boundary.
Making an absent matter present again supplies the positive alternative to force.
Reading and recitation specify the reminder's medium.
Anticipation of harm marks a self-selecting audience already capable of response.
A threat of harm supplies the future object that reminder brings into present awareness.

changed_reading.before: God knows their words; the messenger should warn them but cannot force belief.
changed_reading.after: The ayah partitions agency: God fully knows the resistant speech, while the messenger may reactivate the threatened future through recitation only as non-coercive address to a hearer whose fear already makes response possible.

baseline_models.mechanism: The gathering branch of Quran combines with recollection and the warning's appointed-time branch: recitation can assemble dispersed matter into a renewed present organized around an approaching appointment.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the Quran's functional image as an act that draws materials together.
Recovery after absence turns that gathering into renewed mental presence.
A bounded time or place gives the gathered reminder a future point of orientation.

changed_reading.before: Use scripture as the content of an admonition.
changed_reading.after: Use Quranic recitation as an assembling act that restores dispersed warning-material to present awareness around an approaching appointment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context runs from concealed self-talk to a word expelled from the mouth, then to guarded observation and a word that cannot be substituted. Thus God's knowing what they say closes over the production, emission, custody, and adjudicative stability of speech rather than denoting detached awareness.

activation_trace.role: Hidden self-talk supplies the speech chain's inward starting point.
Casting something from the mouth materializes the transition from inward formation to emitted word.
Guarding supplies continuous custody over each emitted word.
Replacement is negated, making the resulting word resistant to later substitution.
Knowing as disclosure gathers the whole evidentiary chain under divine cognition.
Spoken utterance is the focus anchor completed by that chain.

structural_cues: 50:16, 50:18, and 50:29 sequence concealed speech, emitted speech with a watcher, and a non-substitutable word before 50:45 returns to what they say.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the whisper-emission-watcher-no-substitution sequence; I infer one evidentiary pipeline, while the live alternative is that these scenes independently assert omniscience and judgment.

changed_reading.before: God is aware of the opponents' statements.
changed_reading.after: Their statements are already generated within, emitted, held under watch, and fixed for judgment, so coercing the speakers would add nothing to the complete evidentiary process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder repeatedly joins inward sight, return, lifted covering, and hearing that becomes understanding and compliance. The final fearful hearer is therefore not a target in whom fear is forcibly installed but the last profile of an already receptive process that recitation can reactivate.

activation_trace.role: Insight of the heart makes the first reminder perceptual rather than merely informational.
Habitual return gives the receptive servant a repeatable orientation toward reminder.
Lifting a cover supplies the context's explicit mechanism for latent perception becoming active.
Hearing as understanding and compliance defines reception as more than acoustic exposure.
A reminder again makes the matter present for the listening witness.
The imperative continues the same reactivation process at the focus.
Anticipatory fear names the final receptive condition on which that process can work.

structural_cues: The repeated reminder at 50:8, 50:37, and 50:45 narrows its recipient from every returning servant, to one with a heart who listens as witness, to one who fears the warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring reminder plus sight, return, unveiling, listening, and fear; I infer successive states of one receptive mechanism, while fear could alternatively be only a final audience criterion.

changed_reading.before: Remind whoever is frightened by the warning.
changed_reading.after: Recitation reactivates perception in one already turning, listening, and anticipatorily alert; fear is a sign of receptivity, not a state produced by domination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts forceful seizure with holding oneself steady over their speech. The denial of being a coercer therefore reads as a commanded conversion of hostile verbal pressure into patient, repeated reminder rather than counter-pressure.

activation_trace.role: Seizing with force supplies the nearby image of worldly power that fails to secure escape.
Holding the self back from distress supplies the commanded response to hostile speech.
Their utterance is explicitly the pressure over which restraint is exercised.
The negated coercive branch rules out turning that pressure back upon the speakers.
Renewed presentation replaces force as the continuing action.

structural_cues: 50:36 presents superior force and failed escape; 50:39 commands patience specifically over what they say; 50:45 repeats their speech and denies coercive mastery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the force-patience-speech-coercion sequence; I infer a deliberate response substitution, while the alternative is that 50:39 offers consolation without defining the later role boundary.

changed_reading.before: The messenger lacks authority to compel the rejecters.
changed_reading.after: He is positively directed not to answer verbal resistance with coercive grip: he contains its pressure, continues recitation, and leaves enforcement outside his role.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurrent promise root moves through fulfilled threat, a day marked by warning, warning sent ahead, and a promise addressed to returners; nearness then spatializes its approach. The focus warning remains adverse, but it now belongs to a fixed, approaching pledge-structure with differentiated outcomes rather than to free-floating menace.

activation_trace.role: Threat and menace supply the adverse pole already realized against earlier rejecters.
A bounded appointment turns warning into a day-oriented future event.
Advancing something beforehand gives the warning temporal priority over its fulfillment.
Movement into nearness makes the promised outcome perceptibly approach.
Promise that opens hope supplies the favorable pole offered to the returning and preserving recipient.
The focus retains the specific threatening pole while inheriting the larger pledge sequence.

structural_cues: The same root recurs at 50:14, 50:20, 50:28, 50:32, and 50:45, crossing fulfilled threat, appointed day, advance notice, favorable promise, and final warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the recurrent root and its adverse, temporal, and hopeful branches; I infer one differentiated pledge-system, while the live alternative keeps explicit warning lexically isolated from favorable promise.

changed_reading.before: The hearer fears a threatened punishment.
changed_reading.after: The hearer responds to the adverse side of an already announced and approaching pledge whose context also discloses a favorable promised outcome for receptive returners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant resolution joins focus warning to the preparation branch also activated by two occurrences of ready material; the warning is then said to have been advanced beforehand. This makes the warning sound operationally provisioned by prepared witness and presentation, not merely uttered.

activation_trace.role: Prepared equipment makes the watcher beside each utterance operationally ready.
Prepared provision characterizes what the companion presents as already at hand.
Prior advancement links that readiness to warning delivered before adjudication.
The split-root preparation branch gives the focus warning a secondary resonance of stocked readiness.
The dominant menace branch keeps the prepared resonance anchored to an actual threat.

structural_cues: Ready watcher at 50:18 and ready presentation at 50:23 precede the warning already advanced at 50:28 and feared at 50:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared resolved preparation branch and the repeated readiness/advance sequence; I infer operational backing for the warning, while the materially live alternative treats the split-root overlap as form-distant and retains warning as a speech act only.

changed_reading.before: The warning is a verbal threat about a future penalty.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the warning is already provisioned: watched utterance, ready presentation, and advance notice make its threatened outcome operational rather than empty speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The repair branch is surprising because the form jabbār directly favors coercive power here; it remains anchored in the exact focus root and gains force from the contrast with reminder, but downstream prose should present it only as a secondary lexical resonance, never as the clause's primary translation.

activation_trace.role: Mending fracture or deficiency supplies a secondary image of externally fixing another person.
Coercive overpowering remains the primary negated sense and contains the repair resonance.
Making present again offers a nonmechanical alternative to externally setting the hearer right.

changed_reading.before: You are not a dictator over them.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary resonance, you are also not the one who can mechanically set their inner fracture: offer renewed presence rather than imposed repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The analogy between lexical gathering in Quran and eschatological gathering is cross-domain and does not make the two acts identical; it remains valid because the gathering branch anchors directly in the focus noun and the immediately preceding ayah supplies gathering toward a destination. Render it as a functional echo: voluntary conceptual assembly before compulsory bodily assembly.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فذكر بالقرآن immediately after ذلك حشر علينا يسير

activation_trace.role: Driving and gathering a group toward one destination supplies the immediately preceding compulsory assembly.
Gathering within Quran supplies a voluntary conceptual assembly through recitation.
Renewed presence states what that conceptual assembly does for the receptive hearer.

changed_reading.before: After announcing the gathering, the messenger is told to remind with scripture.
changed_reading.after: The final recitation offers a non-coercive gathering of dispersed awareness before the compulsory gathering just announced becomes bodily actual.

strongest_changes: Speech becomes an end-to-end evidentiary chain rather than a mere object of awareness.
Reminder becomes recovery and unveiling for an already receptive hearer, sharply opposed to coercion.
Warning acquires an approaching pledge structure and, exploratorily, prepared operational backing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah closes the sequence by converting its speech, perception, promise, force, and gathering mechanisms into a bounded communicative mandate: assemble and reactivate through recitation, but do not overpower.
remaining_uncertainties: The favorable promise may remain a contrast to explicit warning rather than coloring it as one differentiated pledge-system.
The prepared-warning model depends on a valid but form-distant split-root resolution and should remain exploratory.
The Quran-gathering and final-gathering relation is a functional echo, not a lexical identity.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge removes the need for coercion while preserving warning.** `ع ل م:B001` supplies clear knowing, `ق و ل:B001` uttered speech, `ج ب ر:B003` coercive compulsion, `ذ ك ر:B009` admonitory reminder, the recitation variant of `ق ر ء:B001`, `خ و ف:B001` anticipation of harm, and `و ع د:B002` threat. The negation and final imperative supply know their speech → do not compel → remind the responsive hearer. I infer that communication, not forced belief, is the messenger's assigned mechanism. The close reads as a limit on human agency within certain divine knowledge.
2. **Reminder can repair without compulsion.** `ج ب ر:B001` supplies repairing fracture and lack, though the negated form directly excludes the coercive `B003`; `ذ ك ر:B003` supplies bringing back to mind. I infer a branch contrast: the addressee is not to force people, but Quranic reminder may still mend cognitive rupture by restoring what fell from attention. The ayah therefore preserves non-coercive repair as the positive counterpart to denied domination.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remained to produce a retrospective surprise. As the final ayah, it instead retrospectively binds the opening Quran, the repeated sayings, the warning, and the reminder into a non-coercive communicative mandate.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The messenger’s work is reparative recollection, not coercion.** `ج ب ر B003` supplies coercive compulsion and is explicitly negated; dormant `ج ب ر B001` supplies repairing fracture and lack. `ذ ك ر B009` supplies reminder, while the collecting/gathering-speech variant of `ق ر ء B001` gives the Qurʾān a reassembling role. The packet supplies the prohibition and the alternative command; I infer that reminder repairs broken continuity by gathering dispersed signs into recitation. The messenger therefore reads as neither controller nor passive announcer, but as one who offers a reparative textual re-collection.

2. **Fear selects receptive attention without being manufactured by force.** `خ و ف B001` supplies anticipatory fear of harm, `و ع د B002` the threat, and `ذ ك ر B003/B009` bringing to mind through admonition. The prior window distinguishes voluntary listening from unavoidable hearing and depicts exit and gathering; the fixed syntax limits the reminder to the one who fears the threat. The packet supplies fear, remembered warning, and non-compulsion; I infer that fear is the pre-existing opening through which recitation can work, not an effect the messenger is authorized to impose. The closing command reads as selective activation of accountable anticipation.

3. **Knowing speech removes any need for domination.** `ع ل م B001` supplies exact knowledge and `ق و ل B007` circulating public talk. Within the local window, 50:41–42 stage caller and cry, while the closing “We know best what they say” assigns evaluation of the opposing speech to the divine speaker before negating human compulsion. The packet supplies governed sound, knowledge, and role-boundary; I infer that coercive control by the messenger would be redundant and misassigned. His action is reminder because the sayings are already known.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remains in the packet, so no later-ayah surprise emerged for this final fixed ayah.

baseline.text: Onların söylediklerini en iyi biz biliriz. Sen onları zorlayacak biri değilsin. Öyleyse tehdidimden korkanlara Kur'an'la hatırlat.

findings.text: Elçinin görevi zorlamak değil, dağılmış işaretleri Kur'an'da yeniden toplayarak kopmuş düşünsel sürekliliği onaran bir hatırlatma sunmaktır.
Tehditten korku, elçinin zorla üreteceği bir durum değil, hatırlatmanın çalışabildiği önceden var olan alıcı açıklıktır.
Onların dolaşan sözleri zaten eksiksiz bilindiği için elçinin baskıyla denetim kurmasına gerek yoktur; değerlendirme ilahî bilgiye, iletişim ise hatırlatmaya bırakılır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3: From Offered Hearing to the Unavoidable Call
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Hearing ranges from a deliberately offered receptive posture to an acoustic disclosure that compels emergence, while reminder itself remains noncoercive.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Attention is something the hearer casts forward, but the final cry reverses initiative by drawing the hidden outward; the Quranic reminder stands between these poles as forceful address without compulsion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reminder Without Compulsion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Recitation gathers words into a reminder that awakens fear of warning without forcing the hearer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: coercion or compulsion `quranic:root_000216:B003/m01`; gathering into a collected text `quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`; reading or reciting `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; a reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; fear `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`; awakening fear `quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`; a threat or warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Recitation forms a collected verbal address, but its efficacy is not mechanical domination. It re-presents the warning so that fear awakens in a receptive hearer, preserving a distinction between compelling attention and coercing assent.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir şeyi bilme ve gerçeğiyle kavramadır; bildirme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında yenme ayrı biçimlere bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bilgisizliğin karşıtı olan temel zihinsel edinimi, tanımayı ve gerçeğe uygun kavrayışı birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun kavrama çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olay veya gelişme hakkındaki haberin kişinin bilgisine ulaşması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberin farkına varma ve ondan bilgi edinme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilginin tekrar ve yönlendirmeyle bir öğrenende yerleşmesini sağlayan öğretim bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin aktarılması ve öğrenende kalıcı bir sonuç oluşturması sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kişi arasındaki bilgi sınamasında bir tarafın ötekini yenmesi bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi alanındaki karşılaştırmayı ve üstün gelme sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri yakın olsa da odak dalın biçime bağlı aktarım ve edinim süreçleri ile komşunun akletme ve hızlı anlama vurgusu karşılıklı değiştirilebilirliği sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı zihinsel erişim ekseninin olumlu ve olumsuz uçlarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bilgiye erişmeyi ve kavramayı bildirirken komşu dal bu erişimin bulunmamasını ya da gerçeğin yanlış bilinmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda yalın bilme ve tanıma, bilginin doğru kullanımından bağımsız olarak çekirdekte yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğruyu bulma, yerinde yargı ve bilgiyi isabetli kullanma niteliğini gerektirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bütün işaret türlerini sınırsızca kapsamaz; kaynakta anılan ayırt etme ve yol gösterme işlevli izlerle bunlara bağlı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı yaratılmışların bütünü, gök düzeni ve içindekiler ya da yaratıkların ayrı sınıfları olarak açıklar. Her sınıfın ve bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; bilme eylemi veya somut işaret dalıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yaratılmış varlıkların bütünü veya sınıflarıyla sınırlıdır; bilme durumu ve bağımsız bir fiziksel işaret anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın evren, yaratılmışların bütünü ve varlık sınıfları anlamlarını verir; başka kuruluşlardan anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaratılmış olanların bütünü; bağlama göre evren ile içindekilerin tamamı veya yaratıkların ayrı ayrı sınıflarıdır. Bu bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması, adın açıklanan dayanağıdır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmış varlıkların tümünü tek bir düzen veya bütün olarak anlatan temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Evreni ve onun içindeki yaratılmışların bütününü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bütün evren yerine insan, görünmeyen varlıklar veya başka bir yaratık cinsi gibi ayrı sınıflara dağıtıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her yaratık cinsinin ayrı bir bütün sayılması yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça üst dudaktaki yarıkla sınırlar; insanın üst dudağının yarılmış olması, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki aynı belirti ve üst dudağı yarma eylemi bu kimliği doğrular. Genel yarılma anlamı veya alt dudaktaki bir biçim bozukluğu bu dala dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti özellikle üst dudakta bulunur; genel çatlaklar, alt dudak ve ağız çevresindeki başka eğrilikler kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Üst dudak yarığı dalın temelidir; yarıklı kişi veya deve nitelemesi ile üst dudağı yarma eylemi ilgili biçimlere bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın üst dudağında veya devenin üst dudak bölgesinde bulunan belirgin yarıktır. Aynı dal, bu özelliği taşıyanı niteleyen biçimi ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Üst dudakta bulunan yarık, dalın anatomik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Üst dudağı yarık insan veya üst dudak bölgesinde bu belirti bulunan deve, özelliği taşıyan varlık olarak nitelenir.
Birinin üst dudağını yarmak, anatomik sonucun oluşturulmasını bildiren eylemsel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yarığın yerini üst dudak olarak ortak biçimde sınırlar ve yarıklı insanı bu özellikle niteler. Toplu tanıklık, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki karşılığını ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de aynı dalda gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki belirgin yarığı adlandıran temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yarığın türünü ve özellikle üst dudaktaki yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanı veya deveyi üst dudak bölgesindeki yarıkla niteleyen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özelliğin taşıyıcıda bulunmasını ve anatomik yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin üst dudağında yarık oluşturma eylemini anlatan kuruluşta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi, etkilenen kişiyi ve üst dudak sınırını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesne, deri, toprak, dağ ve başka yüzeylerdeki genel yarılma ve açılma sürecini kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Genel yarılma dalı süreç ve kapsam farkını, ağız eğriliği dalı ise yakın anatomik karışmayı açıklar; öteki adaylar kırık iyileşmesi, hayvan yapısı veya daha uzak ayrılma türleridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم والشق في الشفة العليا ووصف الرجل أو البعير بالأعلم إذا كان الشق أو العلم في الموضع الأعلى
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو العلم بمعنى المعرفة ولا العلامة الموضوعة اختيارا ولا الشق في الشفة السفلى
branches.source_phrase_ar: العلم الشق في الشفة العليا والرجل أعلم (maqayis)؛ الأعلم الذي انشقت شفته العليا (ayn)؛ علم الرجل يعلم علما إذا صار أعلم وهو المشقوق الشفة العليا (sihah)؛ علمت الرجل أعلمه علما إذا شققت شفته العليا (tahdhib)؛ البعير يقال له أعلم لعلم في مشفره الأعلى (tahdhib)؛ الشق في الشفة العليا علم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık iki karşılığı yan yana verir: bir aktarım sözcüğü deniz olarak açıklar, öteki tanıklıklar ise suyu bol kuyu anlamını destekler. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claim kimlikleri bulunmadığı için bu karşıtlık ortak özet içinde, atıf uydurulmadan korunur.

concept_gloss.text: deniz ya da suyu bol kuyu
concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlük biçiminin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı karşılığını eksiltmeden birlikte göstermek gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını birbirine indirgemeden korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözlük biçiminin geniş su kütlesi karşılığıyla kullanıldığı tanıklığa özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Deniz karşılığını doğal ve doğrudan biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı biçim için tanıklanan suyu bol kuyu karşılığını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözlük biçiminin bol su içeren kuyu karşılığıyla kullanıldığı tanıklıklara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyu türünü ve suyunun çokluğu koşulunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı biçim için tanıklanan deniz karşılığını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal aynı sözlük biçiminin suyu bol kuyu karşılığını da bağımsız bir seçenek olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal deniz yanında büyük ırmak ve farklı büyüklükte su alanlarına uzanan genel bir geniş su kapsamına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Odak dalın deniz karşılığı, komşu dalın geniş ve çok su çekirdeğiyle örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnızca deniz karşılığındadır; odak dalın kuyu seçeneği komşuda bulunmaz, komşunun büyük ırmak ve genel su genişliği ise odak dalın tanımına girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun kendisini suyunun bol olması koşuluyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuyudaki kovadan dökülen veya havuza taşan suyu, kokusunu ve taşma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: suyu bol kuyu ile kuyu suyu
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kuyu çevresinde suyun çokluğu ve görünür birikimiyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal suyu taşıyan kuyuyu niteler; komşu dal ise kuyudan dökülen suyu ve taşma sürecini merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Deniz karşılığını açıklayan geniş su dalı ile kuyu çevresindeki bol su dalı seçildi; diğer adaylar gölet, artık su, taşkın veya su tutan arazi gibi farklı taşıyıcı ve süreçlere bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden yırtıcı kuş için verir ve geçici dal görüntüsünü doğrular. Çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi ise kuş adından türetilmiş ayrı bir biçimdir; kuşun tanımına doğrudan katılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yırtıcı kuş adıdır; çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi yalnızca bu addan türeyen biçime bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş adını tanımlar; insan nitelemesi türemiş bir sözcüksel uzantı olarak bağımlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Doğan veya atmaca türünden bir yırtıcı kuş adıdır. Bu kuş adından türetilen bir niteleme, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği anlatır.

facets.statement: Ad, doğan veya atmaca türünden avcı bir kuşu gösterir.
Kuş adından türeyen insan nitelemesi, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal tek bir sözlük tanıklığında yırtıcı kuş adı ile bu addan türetilmiş çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesini birlikte sunar.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş için verir ve türemiş biçimi çevik, zeki erkek olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: doğan veya atmaca türü yırtıcı kuş

error_profile.preserves: Yırtıcı kuş sınıfını ve doğan ile atmaca karşılıklarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adından türemiş insan nitelemesinin kullanıldığı bağlama özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan oluşu ile çeviklik ve zekâ niteliklerini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca karşılığı taşıyan kuş adını ve ondan türeyen insan nitelemesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal mavi renkli, doğan ile atmaca arasında tanımlanan veya beyaz doğan sayılan daha özel bir kuş adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğan ve atmaca çevresindeki avcı kuş adlandırmaları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aynı kuş alanını paylaşsalar da komşu dal renk ve ara tür özellikleriyle daha dar bir kuşu adlandırır; odak dalın türemiş insan nitelemesi de komşuda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca türünü genel bir adla karşılar ve bu addan insan nitelemesi türetir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle zeki ve keskin bakışlı doğanlara verilen bir adı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: doğan adı ile zeki doğan nitelemesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal doğan türünden yırtıcı kuşları adlandırır ve zekâ çağrışımını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda zekâ kuştan türetilen insan niteliğinde belirginleşir; komşuda ise doğrudan belirli doğanların özelliğidir.

Bu nedenle yapı hem ilişkili anlam gelişmelerini hem de birbirinden kopuk adlandırmaları içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, kırık kemiğin onarılmasını temel alır; aynı giderme ve yeniden bütünleme düzenini yoksunluğun karşılanmasına, bir inanç düzeninin düzeltilip tamamlanmasına ve yenmiş bitkinin yeniden sürmesine taşır. Ekmeğe verilen ad ile hesap işlemi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, zor kullanmayı, erişilmez büyüklüğü, karşılıksız zararı veya bunlarla ilgili adlandırmaları içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kırık kemiği onaran yalın kullanımı temel alır; yoksulluk, inanç düzeni, bitki, ekmek ve hesapla ilgili anlamları yalnızca kendi kayıtlı yapılarında ayrı uzantılar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Kırılmış bir kemiği yeniden birleştirip kaynatmak ya da bir eksikliği gidererek kişiyi veya durumu yeniden yeterli ve bütün hale getirmektir. Bu onarım örüntüsü, belirli kullanımlarda inanç düzeninin tamamlanmasına ve yenmiş bitkinin yeniden sürmesine kadar genişler.

facets.statement: Kırılmış kemiğin parçaları onarılır, birleşir ve yeniden kaynar.
Yoksul kişinin ihtiyacı ve geçim açığı karşılanarak yoksunluğu giderilir.
Bir inanç düzeni başlatılıp düzeltilir ve eksikleri tamamlanır.
Yenmiş veya kurumuş bitki yeniden sürerek kaybını giderir.
İhtiyacı gideren ekmek, onarıcı işlevine gönderme yapan bir adla anılır.
Hesapta, düzeltilmek istenen eksikliği gidermek üzere bir nicelik eklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, kırığın birleşmesinden hareketle bir kaybın giderilmesi ve yeterliliğin yeniden kurulmasıdır. Aynı örüntü yoksunluğun karşılanması, inanç düzeninin tamamlanması, bitkinin yeniden çıkması, ekmeğin ihtiyacı gidermesi ve hesapta eksik niceliğin eklenmesi gibi kayıtlı kullanımlarda görülür.

Geçici çerçevenin Tanrı'ya ilişkin kullanımı dal iddiasında bulunmadığından, bu kullanım yalnızca ayrı sözcük biriminin çevirisinde korunur ve dal tanımına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın ele erişmeyecek ölçüde yükselmesi, uzun, iri ve güçlü olmasıdır. İnsan için bu fiziksel büyüklük örüntüsü, kendini büyük görme, öğüt kabul etmeme ve kibirlenme yönünde genişler.

facets.statement: Ağaç gibi bir varlık ele erişilemeyecek kadar uzar ve yükselir.
Bir kişi uzun, iri ve güçlü oluşuyla başkalarından belirgin biçimde üstün görünür.
Kişi kendini büyük görür, kibirlenir ve başkasının öğüdünü kabul etmez.
Büyüklük taslama ve kibir, bu niteleme ailesindeki soyut adlarla anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatısı, önce elin erişemeyeceği fiziksel uzunluğu ve büyüklüğü, ardından insandaki güç, kendini büyük görme ve öğüt kabul etmeyen kibri verir. Soyut biçimler de bu büyüklük taslayan tutumu adlandırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi istemediği bir işi yapmaya güç ve baskıyla yöneltmek, onun seçimini etkisiz bırakmaktır. Bu çekirdek, zorla egemen olan veya haksız yere öldüren kişi nitelemesine ve insan eylemlerini zorunlu sayan öğretiye genişler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, bir zarar için bedel ya da tazmin sorumluluğu doğmamasını açıkça ortaklaştırır; hayvanın verdiği zarar ile kuyu ve maden kaynaklı kayıplar bu hukuki sonucun kayıtlı örnekleridir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu sınırı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal zarar oluşmasını değil, oluşan zararın karşılıksız kalmasını ve kimseye ödeme yüklenmemesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, karşılıksız zarar çekirdeğini korur; hayvan, kuyu ve maden örneklerini yalnızca kayıtlı niteleme yapılarının kapsamı olarak belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Meydana gelen bir zarar veya kayıp için bedel ödenmemesi ve kimseye tazmin sorumluluğu yüklenmemesidir. Hayvanın verdiği zarar ile kuyu ve maden kaynaklı kayıplar bu sonucun özel örnekleridir.

facets.statement: Bir zarar karşılıksız kalır ve onun için bedel ya da tazmin yükümlülüğü doğmaz.
Bir hayvanın kendiliğinden verdiği zarar için sahibinden bedel alınmaz.
Kuyu veya maden nedeniyle ortaya çıkan belirli kayıplar için tazmin sorumluluğu kurulmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak hükmü, belirli bir zararın bedelsiz ve tazminsiz kalmasıdır. Hayvanın yol açtığı zarar ile kuyu ve maden kaynaklı kayıplar, sorumluluğun düşmesine ilişkin bu çekirdeğin başlıca uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın zararın varlığı ile ödeme yükümlülüğünün yokluğunu birlikte taşıyan genel karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Zararın meydana gelmesini ve bunun için tazmin yükümlülüğü doğmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kayıp için bedel veya tazmin talep edilemediğini anlatan genel hukuki bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zararın giderim ödemesi olmadan bırakılması sonucunu açıkça korur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan zararını ve bu zarar için sahibin sorumlu tutulmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuyu ya da maden kaynaklı belirli kayıplarda kimseye tazmin yüklenmediğini belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyu ve maden örneklerini ödeme sorumluluğunun yokluğuyla birlikte korur.
